cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Carry the table with me, not for me. I'd like us to be partners today. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm stronger. I can do it alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. That's the arrangement I'm trying to stop calling our friendship.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Take the other end.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Now ask where we're putting it instead of deciding for both ends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me write the complaint as a colleague, not my parent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was only correcting your spelling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave the angry sentence. That's my contribution.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quite a good sentence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put both our names under it, not 'on behalf of.'

cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Stay until the tea cools. You always rush goodbye. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's cold now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then I wasn't really waiting for the tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What were you waiting for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A goodbye that doesn't sound like you're already somewhere else. Have another sip.

beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Thank you for apologising for missing my concert. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So we're okay?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Closer. Now why did I have to ask whether you'd noticed missing it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't know what to say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for letting me rehearse your apology alone all week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for apologising for missing my concert.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So we're okay?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Closer. Now why did I have to ask whether you'd noticed missing it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't know what to say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for letting me rehearse your apology alone all week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I accept your apology for breaking the vase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The vase was cheap. You let me blame the dog for three days.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was embarrassed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell the dog and me which part of that embarrassment we deserved.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Excellent. It's for the chair of my new tenants' committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I approved furniture, not a committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then welcome to our first agenda item: what your chair authorises.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You said you'd take it from here. Here are the unanswered wedding invitations. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant I'd answer the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. These people need an answer before reaching it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's not the same job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then help me explain where your generous offer ended.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then help me explain where your generous offer ended.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember volunteering to finish the last detail of the fete?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The banner, yes.

beats.text: The banner announces a raffle nobody has organised.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I offered to paint words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And 'raffle' is the word still needing the most work.
